description: CO2MPAS-TA is a vehicle simulator from the European Commission Joint Research Centre for estimating NEDC carbon dioxide emissions from WLTP test information. Users supply vehicle test-cycle, powertrain and measured values; outputs are calculated CO2 figures for the type-approval comparison. Its geographic and regulatory scope is European vehicle approval, although vehicle physics can be studied elsewhere. The README provides the program identity, documentation and installation route, and GitHub metadata states EUPL-1.1 licensing. A limitation is that a test-cycle emissions estimate is not a measure of real-world fleet emissions on a particular road or in congestion. The simulator can supply vehicle-emission assumptions to transport infrastructure or air-quality scenarios. The related catalogue SUMO record simulates traffic movement, not vehicle type-approval carbon conversion. No vehicle datasets or simulator package were downloaded.
name: CO2MPAS vehicle emissions simulator
